tasks.title: Repair development launcher environment and IPv4 readiness
tasks.reason: Development launcher and sensitive bypass qualification must agree without overriding explicit environments or granting guest authority.
acceptance: Success: Given bypass explicitly enabled and an isolated fixture, when the development launcher has no explicit NODE_ENV, then it passes development to the API and recognizes exact IPv4 health without Login configuration.

Negative: Given explicit production/test or invalid/missing fixture, when qualifying bypass, then it still denies before protected imports; HTTP errors, invalid health and unreachable endpoints are not ready.

Recovery: Given restart or bypass off, when polling health, then the read-only unavailable guest shell can listen without granting private authority, and existing fixtures/environment values are not overwritten.
